name: Quantized Knot Position and Coefficient Computation
definition: A method to compute quantized knots $(\tilde{t}_k, \tilde{a}_{k0}, \dots, \tilde{a}_{kD})$ and localized difference coefficients $\tilde{a}_{kd}$ that encode a continuous contribution approximation $A(t)$ as a piecewise polynomial function with compact support and shifted evenness.
summary: Quantized Knot Position and Coefficient Computation converts floating-point particle attributes into integer knot positions and coefficients to enable exact integer arithmetic and prevent error propagation in volume rendering.
